policy: One point per place and part; action requires an action reference with original evidence in a member chapter. Chapter associations and CSV evidence remain available in full.

groups.title: Part I
groups.text: The Oblonsky household is shaken by infidelity, while Levin seeks Kitty’s hand. Anna’s arrival in Moscow brings her into Vronsky’s path.

introductions.en: The Oblonsky household is shaken by infidelity, while Levin seeks Kitty’s hand. Anna’s arrival in Moscow brings her into Vronsky’s path.
introductions.it: L’infedeltà sconvolge la casa degli Oblonskij, mentre Levin chiede la mano di Kitty. L’arrivo di Anna a Mosca incrocia il suo destino con quello di Vronskij.
introductions.fr: L’infidélité bouleverse la maison des Oblonski, tandis que Lévine demande la main de Kitty. L’arrivée d’Anna à Moscou met Vronski sur son chemin.
introductions.es: La infidelidad sacude la casa de los Oblonski, mientras Levin pide la mano de Kitty. La llegada de Anna a Moscú cruza su destino con el de Vronski.

groups.title: Part II
groups.text: Anna and Vronsky’s bond becomes an affair, and Karenin grows uneasy. Kitty seeks recovery at Soden, while Levin returns to the work of his estate.

introductions.en: Anna and Vronsky’s bond becomes an affair, and Karenin grows uneasy. Kitty seeks recovery at Soden, while Levin returns to the work of his estate.
introductions.it: Il legame fra Anna e Vronskij diventa una relazione, e Karenin si inquieta. Kitty cerca di riprendersi a Soden, mentre Levin torna al lavoro nella sua tenuta.
introductions.fr: Le lien entre Anna et Vronski devient une liaison, et Karénine s’inquiète. Kitty cherche à se rétablir à Soden, tandis que Lévine reprend le travail de son domaine.
introductions.es: El vínculo entre Anna y Vronski se convierte en una relación, y Karenin se inquieta. Kitty busca recuperarse en Soden, mientras Levin vuelve al trabajo de su finca.

groups.title: Part III
groups.text: Levin mows with the peasants and questions how the land should be worked. Anna and Vronsky struggle with their future as Karenin insists on preserving appearances.

introductions.en: Levin mows with the peasants and questions how the land should be worked. Anna and Vronsky struggle with their future as Karenin insists on preserving appearances.
introductions.it: Levin falcia con i contadini e si interroga sul lavoro della terra. Anna e Vronskij affrontano l’incertezza del loro futuro, mentre Karenin impone di salvare le apparenze.
introductions.fr: Lévine fauche avec les paysans et s’interroge sur le travail de la terre. Anna et Vronski affrontent leur avenir incertain, tandis que Karénine exige de sauver les apparences.
introductions.es: Levin siega con los campesinos y reflexiona sobre el trabajo de la tierra. Anna y Vronski afrontan un futuro incierto, mientras Karenin exige guardar las apariencias.

groups.title: Part IV
groups.text: Levin and Kitty find their way back to each other. Anna’s grave illness brings Karenin’s forgiveness and Vronsky’s despair, before the lovers leave for Italy.

introductions.en: Levin and Kitty find their way back to each other. Anna’s grave illness brings Karenin’s forgiveness and Vronsky’s despair, before the lovers leave for Italy.
introductions.it: Levin e Kitty si ritrovano. La grave malattia di Anna suscita il perdono di Karenin e la disperazione di Vronskij, prima della partenza degli amanti per l’Italia.
introductions.fr: Lévine et Kitty se retrouvent. La grave maladie d’Anna suscite le pardon de Karénine et le désespoir de Vronski, avant le départ des amants pour l’Italie.
introductions.es: Levin y Kitty vuelven a encontrarse. La grave enfermedad de Anna provoca el perdón de Karenin y la desesperación de Vronski, antes de que los amantes partan hacia Italia.

groups.title: Part V
groups.text: Marriage opens a new life for Levin and Kitty, soon shadowed by Nikolai’s death. Anna and Vronsky’s Italian happiness gives way to painful encounters on their return to Petersburg.

introductions.en: Marriage opens a new life for Levin and Kitty, soon shadowed by Nikolai’s death. Anna and Vronsky’s Italian happiness gives way to painful encounters on their return to Petersburg.
introductions.it: Il matrimonio apre una nuova vita a Levin e Kitty, presto segnata dalla morte di Nikolaj. La felicità italiana di Anna e Vronskij lascia spazio agli incontri dolorosi del ritorno a Pietroburgo.
introductions.fr: Le mariage ouvre une nouvelle vie à Lévine et Kitty, bientôt assombrie par la mort de Nikolaï. Le bonheur italien d’Anna et Vronski cède la place aux rencontres douloureuses du retour à Pétersbourg.
introductions.es: El matrimonio abre una nueva vida a Levin y Kitty, pronto ensombrecida por la muerte de Nikolái. La felicidad italiana de Anna y Vronski deja paso a los encuentros dolorosos del regreso a Petersburgo.

groups.title: Part VI
groups.text: Summer life at Pokrovskoye contrasts with Anna and Vronsky’s luxurious estate, which Dolly visits. Hunting, jealousy and the noble elections unsettle both households.

introductions.en: Summer life at Pokrovskoye contrasts with Anna and Vronsky’s luxurious estate, which Dolly visits. Hunting, jealousy and the noble elections unsettle both households.
introductions.it: La vita estiva a Pokrovskoe contrasta con la lussuosa tenuta di Anna e Vronskij, visitata da Dolly. Caccia, gelosia ed elezioni nobiliari turbano entrambe le case.
introductions.fr: La vie estivale à Pokrovskoïe contraste avec le domaine luxueux d’Anna et Vronski, visité par Dolly. Chasse, jalousie et élections nobiliaires troublent les deux foyers.
introductions.es: La vida veraniega en Pokróvskoye contrasta con la lujosa finca de Anna y Vronski, que visita Dolly. La caza, los celos y las elecciones de la nobleza alteran ambos hogares.

groups.title: Part VII
groups.text: In Moscow, Kitty gives birth and Levin encounters Anna. Anna’s isolation and jealousy deepen until her final railway journey to Obiralovka.

introductions.en: In Moscow, Kitty gives birth and Levin encounters Anna. Anna’s isolation and jealousy deepen until her final railway journey to Obiralovka.
introductions.it: A Mosca Kitty partorisce e Levin incontra Anna. L’isolamento e la gelosia di Anna si aggravano fino al suo ultimo viaggio ferroviario a Obiralovka.
introductions.fr: À Moscou, Kitty accouche et Lévine rencontre Anna. L’isolement et la jalousie d’Anna s’aggravent jusqu’à son dernier voyage en train vers Obiralovka.
introductions.es: En Moscú, Kitty da a luz y Levin conoce a Anna. El aislamiento y los celos de Anna se agravan hasta su último viaje ferroviario a Obiralovka.

groups.title: Part VIII
groups.text: Vronsky leaves with the volunteers bound for Serbia. At Pokrovskoye, Levin searches for meaning and discovers a new understanding of faith, family and daily life.

introductions.en: Vronsky leaves with the volunteers bound for Serbia. At Pokrovskoye, Levin searches for meaning and discovers a new understanding of faith, family and daily life.
introductions.it: Vronskij parte con i volontari diretti in Serbia. A Pokrovskoe Levin cerca il senso della vita e scopre un nuovo rapporto con la fede, la famiglia e la quotidianità.
introductions.fr: Vronski part avec les volontaires en route pour la Serbie. À Pokrovskoïe, Lévine cherche le sens de la vie et découvre un nouveau rapport à la foi, à la famille et au quotidien.
introductions.es: Vronski parte con los voluntarios rumbo a Serbia. En Pokróvskoye, Levin busca el sentido de la vida y descubre una nueva relación con la fe, la familia y la vida cotidiana.
